content.text: /ext:medcp Which antihypertensive classes are most commonly prescribed in adults 40-60?

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.concept_code, c.vocabulary_id, c.concept_class_id
FROM omop.concept c
WHERE c.vocabulary_id='ATC'
  AND c.concept_code IN ('C02','C03','C07','C08','C09')
ORDER BY c.concept_code

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT atc.concept_name AS antihypertensive_class,
       COUNT(*) AS prescription_records,
       COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS patients
FROM omop.drug_exposure de
JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = de.person_id
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
JOIN omop.concept atc ON atc.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
WHERE atc.vocabulary_id = 'ATC'
  AND atc.concept_code IN ('C02','C03','C07','C08','C09')
  AND de.drug_exposure_start_date IS NOT NULL
  AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM de.drug_exposure_start_date) - p.year_of_birth) BETWEEN 40 AND 60
GROUP BY atc.concept_name
ORDER BY prescription_records DESC;

SELECT atc.concept_name AS antihypertensive_class,
       COUNT(*) AS prescription_records,
       COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS patients
FROM omop.drug_exposure de
JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = de.person_id
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
JOIN omop.concept atc ON atc.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
WHERE atc.vocabulary_id = 'ATC'
  AND atc.concept_code IN ('C02','C03','C07','C08','C09')
  AND de.drug_exposure_start_date IS NOT NULL
  AND (YEAR(de.drug_exposure_start_date) - p.year_of_birth) BETWEEN 40 AND 60
GROUP BY atc.concept_name
ORDER BY prescription_records DESC;

Among adults age 40–60 in the OMOP EHR data, the most commonly prescribed antihypertensive classes were:

| Rank | Class | Prescription records | Patients |
|---:|---|---:|---:|
| 1 | Beta blocking agents | 1,062,426 | 61,795 |
| 2 | Diuretics | 882,420 | 42,389 |
| 3 | Calcium channel blockers | 704,022 | 37,563 |
| 4 | Agents acting on the renin-angiotensin system | 434,759 | 43,772 |
| 5 | Antihypertensives, other | 424,475 | 24,213 |

I counted OMOP `drug_exposure` records mapped through ATC classes `C02`, `C03`, `C07`, `C08`, and `C09`, with age approximated as `YEAR(drug_exposure_start_date) - year_of_birth` between 40 and 60.
